descricao_original: This freeze fracture image of a lymphocyte shows a fracture plane where separation has occurred between the outer and inner nuclear membranes, exposing the perinuclear space. Organelles, e.g., mitochondria and vesicles, are also visible in the cytoplasm. 12,000x
